changes.title: Visible desktop navigation
changes.detail: Six clear groups — Play, Calendar, Tournaments, Coaching, Club and News — replace the desktop-only hamburger journey. Group names open their overview pages; separate controls open the dropdowns. The arrows now align with the menu labels.

changes.title: Membership layout restored in both versions
changes.detail: Five fee cards, four benefits, shared club statistics, joining steps, etiquette/policy links, junior information and five expandable FAQs replace the flattened text. Existing fee amounts and public payment instructions are retained. Fees, cards, steps and actions are native Contentful entries.

changes.title: About Us content and layout restored in both versions
changes.detail: The original introduction, five committee portraits, ten volunteers, three affiliation logos, sixteen arbiter names, governance links, venue map, opening hours and joining actions are restored. Names and roles are editable cards in Contentful; the existing source’s spelling differences still need club confirmation.

changes.title: Policies managed as a Contentful type
changes.detail: Seven existing approved club documents are published as reusable Club policy entries. Membership etiquette, privacy and tournament-rule links open the relevant section of the Policies hub. About, Juniors and Tournaments also use these references. Editors can replace documents, change titles, reorder policies or hide an entry without changing code.

changes.title: Join, login and quick tasks
changes.detail: Join / Renew and Member Login sit in the desktop header. What's On, Register for an Event and Pairings & Results sit below it. All five tasks are near the top of the mobile menu.

changes.title: Simpler navigation groups
changes.detail: Junior Chess is under Play. Coaching has its own group. History, champions, Peter Caissa, committee, arbiters, sponsors, membership, policies and contact are grouped under Club. Finished 2026 event bookings are removed from the upcoming menu; their historical pages remain.

changes.title: A First Visit section
changes.detail: Play now opens with choosing an activity, arriving early, equipment and venue guidance. It includes the existing weekly session times and direct links to the club calendar, junior chess and enquiries.

changes.title: A dedicated Coaching page
changes.detail: Programs and levels, the existing four named coaches, Term 4 dates, parent policies, private coaching and an enquiry/term-details gateway are collected in one place. Juniors and Coaching use the same program and coach cards.

changes.title: Accurate coaching availability wording
changes.detail: The review says current group ticket sales have ended and one-on-one tickets are sold out. New families can enquire and follow the existing registration/orientation process. Actual class times depend on the group and coach.

changes.title: A Tournaments routing hub
changes.detail: One section connects upcoming competitions, event registration, pairings/results, live boards, games/PGNs and Oceania Youth 2027. Recurring flagship events now have readable names and cards. The inherited, unsupported Grandmaster description of Igor Koshnitsky is omitted.

changes.title: Calendar links you can share
changes.detail: Senior, junior, coaching and social filters open directly from navigation and page links. The chosen category, view and month stay in the URL, survive reload, and follow browser Back/Forward.

changes.title: An upcoming agenda
changes.detail: What's On shows remaining dates across future months rather than only the current month. Month and monthly agenda views are retained, together with an iCalendar download.

changes.title: Term 4 calendar corrections
changes.detail: Coaching sessions 4–8 move to 7, 14, 21 and 28 November and 5 December, following the current booking page. A clearly named coaching break appears on 31 October. The junior championship round on 31 October remains, and 28 November is labelled as a junior tournament break rather than a whole-club closure.

changes.title: Clear calendar sources and next steps
changes.detail: Affected coaching and junior championship dates link to their event details. The original annual PDF is available as a secondary download and is labelled as an older source with later corrections in the review calendar.

changes.title: Seven aligned sponsor profiles
changes.detail: The full audit restored Bacchus Marsh Grammar, which was present on WordPress but absent from the six homepage-derived profiles. Seven native sponsor entries now use consistent logo areas, heading positions and card heights. Benefits, statistics, package headings, inclusion lists, activations, process steps, FAQs and enquiry actions have proper layouts. The GS Chess destination is restored. V2 retains enquiries for current prices and availability.

changes.title: Champions newest first, including 2025
changes.detail: Julian McIntyre is added as the 2025 club champion with 5 points, verified against final round-seven standings. Twelve Club champion records are native Contentful entries, automatically ordered newest first. The latest winner links to the final results; original gaps are retained for club confirmation.

changes.title: Missing Play, Junior and Tournament content restored
changes.detail: Fresh WordPress comparison found eight missing Play points, four parent-information points and seven tournament/rules points. All nineteen are restored. Native cards, image/text sections, steps, original introductions, FAQs and hero actions replace flattened content. Programs and coaches remain shared between Juniors and Coaching.

changes.title: Contact page rebuilt with the omitted visitor information
changes.detail: The map, session guidance, address/directions, visitor advice, arrival and forfeit information, etiquette policy and useful enquiry/event/membership actions are restored. Email is the working contact destination. Duplicate source text and placeholder shop/buttons are removed; coaching times point to the current term/group listing.

changes.title: Every migrated page reviewed
changes.detail: All fourteen core pages were compared with fresh WordPress content, including photos, tables, links, lists and maps. History, Best in the West and Peter Caissa retain their original material and now lose leaked shortcodes in both versions. The full audit records intentional differences and outstanding club decisions; download it above.

changes.title: Useful privacy and policy destinations
changes.detail: A Privacy & Photography page links to the existing approved document. Footer privacy links open it. The misleading Cookie Policy link is removed; the Policies hub retains its documents.

changes.title: Inherited content cleanup
changes.detail: Exposed WordPress timeline shortcodes are removed from History, Champions, Best in the West and Peter Caissa. The junior age placeholder is replaced with an enquiry. Obvious capitalisation/address-label errors are corrected. Ended live broadcasts are clearly labelled Broadcast Archive.

changes.title: A separate review version
changes.detail: Navigation and calendar proposals stay inside /v2/. Membership, About Us, policies and full page-audit repairs are shared fixes published in Contentful and shown in both rebuilt versions. Every review page has a banner linking to this change list and is excluded from search indexing. The original WordPress domain remains unchanged.
